messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick check 1: new hire gets a small monthly on-call stipend and will go on unpaid leave mid-June. Theyd like $60 of that stipend to keep going to 401(k) and HSA if possible. How do we make that happen?

Ibrahim (Eng): stipend is paid as a separate line item in payroll feed, we usually tag it ONCALL_STIP.

Leo (Payroll): If it's coded as ONCALL_STIP (taxable earnings) and the employee has deferral elections on file, payroll will apply 401(k) deferrals automatically. HSA pre-tax deductions also apply only if there are taxable wages in the pay period. If the rest of the period is unpaid, the stipend alone can support pre-tax HSA deductions if entered before cutoff.

Maya (People Ops): Any vendor minimums or export timing to watch for?

Leo (Payroll): Two things: 1) Some recordkeepers enforce contribution minimums (rare)  i will confirm for our plan. 2) Payroll changes must be in the system before the payroll cutoff (we recommend 48 hours before pay date). Small amounts like $60 usually pass through.

Benefits Bot: Added doc link: benefits/401k-recordkeeper-integration (internal).

Leo (Payroll): Next steps: employee should confirm they want the deferral from the stipend, submit a one-off election ticket if they need a special election, and we need the ticket before cutoff. I'll ping recordkeeper about minimums and reply here.

Maya (People Ops): thanks Leo, please add a short KB note we can point hires to.

Leo (Payroll): Will do  draft: "Deferring stipends during unpaid leave: code as ONCALL_STIP, submit election before payroll cutoff (48h), recordkeeper min may apply." I'll post when confirmed.

(End of thread)
